narrative.intro: Bechtel National reported $627M in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Bechtel National recorded 1 award in the current fiscal-year period, producing an average award size of $627M. Bechtel National obligations are down 40.7% year over year. Historical annual obligations show variability: Bechtel National had $1.2B in FY21, $763M in FY22, $986M in FY23, $929M in FY24, and $1.1B in FY25. Current-year totals are partial because the period covers fiscal year to date, and the reported figures are contract obligations except where table notes indicate award-value totals. Use the obligations trend to compare scale across years: FY25 and FY21 are the largest single-year obligations on record, while FY26 to date is smaller than the prior full fiscal years. The dataset lists award counts and values but does not include a breakdown by agency, product category, or contract expiration dates in the provided figures.

sections.heading: How has federal spending for Bechtel National changed year over year?
sections.body: Bechtel National obligations fell 40.7% year over year. Bechtel National had $1.1B in obligations in FY25 and has $627M in FY26 to date. Bechtel National experienced higher obligations in FY21 and FY25 compared with the current fiscal-year total.

sections.heading: How do FY26 obligations compare to past fiscal years?
sections.body: Bechtel National obligations for FY26 to date are $627M. Bechtel National posted $1.2B in FY21, $763M in FY22, $986M in FY23, $929M in FY24, and $1.1B in FY25. Bechtel National's FY26 to-date total is lower than each of FY21, FY23, FY24, and FY25 and lower than FY22.
